children: U.S. East coast distillate stockpiles fell to a record low of 19.3 million barrels in the week ended August 28, the Energy Information Administration (EIA) said on Wednesday, based on data going back to 1990.
Total U.S. refinery utilization rose to 98% during the week, the highest level since August 2018, EIA data showed. Refineries in the Midwest operated at a record 103.5% of capacity.
Net crude oil inputs to U.S. refineries increased to 17.5 million barrels per day (bpd), the highest since August 2019, the data showed.
U.S. crude oil production rose to 13.9 million bpd, matching the record high reached in November 2025, the EIA data showed.
